paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper sets multiple limits: DM-electron cross section, axioelectric coupling g_Ae (AxionElectron), dark photon kinetic mixing kappa (DarkPhoton), and sterile neutrino mixing |Ue4|^2. Stronger limits on g_Ae and kappa for masses 0.03-0.2 keV/c^2 (30-200 eV). No numerical exclusion values given in text or tables; limits only shown in Fig. 2 (90% C.L.). Local DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3 per Standard Halo Model. Coupling type ambiguous between AxionElectron and DarkPhoton; chose AxionElectron per hint, but no extractable numerical data points. | Vision: Traced the DarkSide-50 2022 solid red curve in the middle-left axion-like particle plot. NOTE: The provided calibration (y 1e-40 to 1e-35, x 5-1000 MeV) corresponds to the cross-section plot (top-left), not the axion-electron plot. The g_Ae plot actually uses x-axis m_A in keV/c2 (~0.04 to 20 keV) and y-axis g_Ae from ~1e-14 to >1e-11. Reported values use the actual g_Ae plot axes since that matches the requested coupling type. Masses converted to eV (keV*1000). | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=2.3x
